_what_it_tests: Codes with no catalog entry. describe() degrades instead of raising.
_expect: Each renders with the CORRECT zone icon but the generic description 'Unrecognized code — needs diagnosis' and severity 'info'. Zone comes from the prefix (faults.py:95) so it works on codes we have never catalogued; description and severity come from the catalog (faults.py:72,82) so they fall back.
_why_it_matters: This is what a real car will hand you constantly. The catalog has 18 codes; the standard has thousands, and manufacturer-specific P1xxx codes are per-make (DIAG-3). The UI must stay useful when it only knows WHERE a fault is, not WHAT it is.
_codes_chosen: P0128 thermostat, P0455 gross EVAP leak, P0740 torque converter clutch, C0040 right front wheel speed. All real generic codes, deliberately left out of catalog-additions.json so this scenario keeps working after you merge those.
